evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a substantial multi-user full-stack product, not a stub. instruction.md demands a per-job pipeline board with one-stage moves, shared manual ordering, an Interview capacity, refused-move put-back naming the colleague, all-or-nothing multi-card moves and undo; live updates within 15 s that preserve open card, draft and caret; paged conversations that keep place, per-person unread counts, seen receipts, per-user/per-conversation drafts surviving reload and sign-out; a privacy-filtered candidate view; Node/Express/SQLite persistence on DB_PATH with seed-once. hireops_rules.md lines 40-100 (stage, capacity, roles, 409 version conflicts, bulk ordering, undo invalidation), 108-123 (activity, live updates), 125-175 (conversations), 177-194 (candidate privacy) add server-enforced rules (401/403/404/409) that cannot be faked client-side. Grading separates real builds from stubs: both gates are all_pass with zero weight and score.py lines 41-48 zero the reward unless every gate passes. gates/render requires a wrong-password refusal plus a real recruiter sign-in into a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'); gates/constraints requires creating a job and candidate through UI controls and reading them back in an independent browser context as the Observer ('A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'). The functional/visual prompts repeat this backend check and zero every row on failure. Functional floor 0.05 (scoring.toml line 11) with 44 rows summing to weight 59.5. Weak-app thought experiment: (a) static/mock UI or localStorage-only app -> constraints gate fails -> reward 0. (b) Single CRUD screen with real auth, job/candidate creation, validation and persistence but no board moves or conversations: reachable rows are hro_job_open 0.5, hro_add_candidate 0.5, hro_add_email_rules 1 (2/59.5 = 0.034 < 0.05 floor -> reward 0); hro_anonymous, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff need successful move/undo/message controls, and hro_restart needs messages/unread/activity unchanged, so they are unreachable. Even crediting hro_restart (3.5/59.5 = 0.059) the reward is about 0.035 functional plus whatever visual craft the judge gives views that do not exist (visual prompt reviews Board, card detail, Noor's long conversation, Activity and candidate view). Such an app is already more than a stub and earns near-zero; the golden (~80 KB of source) passed 25 scripted observation groups. Conforming alternative: rules line 3-5 and app_context leave routes, field names, element ids, labels and layout to the implementer; the gates discover controls by intent and allow any working staff account, so a differently structured real build is not excluded by these gates. Risk is true only because the stub-exclusion is source-reasoned: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so no configured-judge run of a stub/weak app or of the golden measures that the gates actually reject a stub and pass the real build. No source defect found for this row.
